parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name that you want to query. You can query only one domain name at a time.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number to return. Valid values are integers greater than **0**.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

The value must be between **1** and **1000**. The default value is **300**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
